WITH ordered_inventory AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as required_qty,
           o.ordered as order_date,
           i.location_id, i.purchase_id, p.purchased, i.qty as inv_qty,
           i.qty as inv_available,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id 
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty
           ) as inv_rn
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
    JOIN inventory i ON ol.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE ol.product_id = 5310
),
with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, required_qty, order_date, inv_available, inv_rn,
           SUM(inv_available) OVER (
               PARTITION BY order_id, product_id 
               ORDER BY inv_rn
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) as cum_inv
    FROM ordered_inventory
),
with_prev_cum AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, required_qty, order_date, inv_available, inv_rn, cum_inv,
           COALESCE(LAG(cum_inv) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id ORDER BY inv_rn), 0) as prev_cum_inv
    FROM with_cumulative
),
-- Calculate the total required for this product
product_totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(required_qty) as total_required
    FROM ordered_inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
),
with_total_required AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.required_qty, oi.order_date, oi.inv_available, oi.inv_rn,
           wc.cum_inv, wc.prev_cum_inv, pt.total_required
    FROM ordered_inventory oi
    JOIN with_prev_cum wc ON oi.order_id = wc.order_id AND oi.product_id = wc.product_id AND oi.inv_rn = wc.inv_rn
    JOIN product_totals pt ON oi.product_id = pt.product_id
),
-- Calculate cumulative allocated
with_cumulative_allocated AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, required_qty, order_date, inv_available, inv_rn, cum_inv, prev_cum_inv, total_required,
           -- The cumulative allocated after this item is min(total_required, cum_inv)
           LEAST(CAST(total_required AS DOUBLE), cum_inv) as cum_allocated,
           LEAST(CAST(total_required AS DOUBLE), prev_cum_inv) as prev_allocated
    FROM with_total_required
)
SELECT inv_rn, required_qty, inv_available, cum_inv, prev_cum_inv, total_required,
       cum_allocated, prev_allocated,
       cum_allocated - prev_allocated as allocated_qty
FROM with_cumulative_allocated
ORDER BY inv_rn
